bifrost: springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter), springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs, springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_view.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_texture.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_mesh.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_sprites.rs
summary: MetalKit is Apple's Metal helper layer: a view that owns a drawable loop (MTKView), a texture loader, and Model I/O mesh wrappers. BifrOSt has a GPU presenter with a Metal-shaped internal API (device, drawables, one render pass per present) on GLES, but no app-facing SDK equivalent of any MetalKit class, and no mesh handling. Wave 15 (2026-10-19) adds app-facing SDK modules: gpu_view (a view with a delegate and a drawable pool), gpu_texture (a texture loader with an async batch), gpu_mesh (meshes from shapes and OBJ, STL and PLY files) and gpu_sprites (a sprite batch drawn into a drawable). All of it is CPU reference code: drawables and textures are CPU images until the shell presenter takes them.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/render_loop.rs; springboard/ui/src/render_view.rs (RenderView: drawable size from bounds and content scale, automatic resizing, the loop and draw requests); springboard/sdk/src/gpu_view.rs (GpuView, GpuViewDelegate, Frame, FrameOutcome); springboard/ui/src/render_view.rs (pause on resign)
features.note: The render view model is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs: drawable size from bounds and scale, automatic and manual resizing with change reports, and the paused, timed and on-demand loop, alongside the loop tests in render_loop.rs and parity_sdk-tests-05.rs. Gap: no app-facing GPU view or per-frame draw delegate is attached, and the presenter stays internal to the shell, which needs a GPU device and the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19 (parity/w15-gpu-kits): sdk gpu_view::GpuView joins RenderView, the sdk DrawablePool and a GpuViewDelegate. drawable_size_will_change is called once before the first pass and after every change (also while the loop is paused); draw(&mut Frame) gets a drawable already cleared to the clear colour; a drawn drawable is queued for the presenter (take_presented, image, release); a size change waits until the presenter has released every drawable; draw() forces a pass; pause on resign and resume on active pass through. Still a gap: drawables are CPU images, the shell presenter does not take them yet and no GPU device handle reaches the app. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app gpu_view::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (first pass, timed loop, pool exhaustion, size change while paused, on-demand, pause with the app); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.bifrost: springboard/ui/src/drawable_setup.rs (DrawableSetup::validate, FORMAT_OPAQUE, FORMAT_ALPHA); springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs (Presenter::create_surface, line 380); springboard/src/gpu/egl.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_view.rs (GpuView::drawable_request, set_opaque, set_preferred_device)
features.note: A drawable request is validated headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-rest-12.rs: zero sides, the device side limit, render node paths, the presenter format codes and buffer sizes. Gap: the shell's GBM and EGL presenter does not take these requests yet, and no app receives a device or drawable handle; checking the real device limit needs the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: GpuView::drawable_request validates the live drawable (size, FORMAT_OPAQUE or FORMAT_ALPHA, render node path) with DrawableSetup and refuses a side above MAX_DRAWABLE_SIDE (16384) or more than 2^26 pixels before any image is made. Still a gap: the shell's GBM and EGL presenter does not take the request, and the real device limit needs the lab machine. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app gpu_view::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (drawable_requests_follow_the_view_and_refuse_bad_ones, a_drawable_with_too_many_pixels_is_refused_before_any_image_is_made); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs (decode, PNG and JPEG); springboard/src/gpu/mod.rs (upload, line 352); springboard/ui/src/texture_catalog.rs (named images with scale variants); springboard/ui/src/texture_loader.rs (background load requests); springboard/sdk/src/gpu_texture.rs (TextureLoader, Texture, PendingTextures)
features.note: Images decode to RGBA on the CPU and upload to GLES. A named lookup that picks the scale variant for the screen is tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-complete-33.rs. Gap: no app-facing GPU texture object and no asynchronous upload to GLES, and the upload path needs a GPU and the lab machine. Built 2026-10-19: gpu_texture::TextureLoader makes a Texture (descriptor plus pixel levels) from bytes, a file, a TextureCatalog name with scale variants, or a decoded Image, with the texture LoadOptions (sRGB, mipmap allocate or generate, origin, usage); headers are checked before decode (side limit and 2^26 pixels), files are capped at 256 MiB; load_async decodes a batch on a background thread and PendingTextures::poll or wait returns each result by index; Texture has replace_region, pixel, sample_nearest and a label. Still a gap: no GPU texture object and no upload to GLES from the SDK, and no colour-space tag. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app gpu_texture::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (bytes, origin flip, mipmaps, catalog variants, region replace, async batch); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.feature: Model I/O mesh handling (MTKMesh, MTKSubmesh, MTKMeshBuffer, allocator)
features.bifrost: springboard/render/src/mesh.rs, springboard/render/src/texture.rs; springboard/sdk/src/gpu_mesh.rs (box_asset, plane_asset, sphere_asset, load_mesh_file, mesh_from_primitive)
features.note: Wave 1 (parity/integration 0d0412c3): pure model with host unit tests; not wired into apps or the shell, not yet tested on the VM or Midget. No mesh, vertex-descriptor or index-buffer type outside the shell's internal 2D batch (springboard/src/gpu/batch.rs, a fixed 64-byte quad vertex) Refreshed 2026-10-17: the mesh model and loader exist in bifrost-ui (ui/src/mesh.rs, mesh_primitives.rs, mesh_file.rs; tests in those modules) and in render/src/mesh.rs; they are not re-exported to apps and have no GPU draw path. Built 2026-10-19: the mesh model is now exported to apps through gpu_mesh: shapes and OBJ, STL and ASCII PLY files become a render::mesh::Mesh (interleaved position, normal and uv, one triangle submesh with 16-bit or 32-bit indices) from a BufferAllocator with a byte budget; hostile files are refused (size cap, bad indices, non-UTF-8 text, unknown extension) and a failed build gives its bytes back. Still a gap: no GPU draw path for a mesh, no tangents, no other file formats. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app gpu_mesh::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (box, sphere, 32-bit indices, budget, OBJ, STL, PLY, hostile files); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.apple: (no direct MetalKit class; Metal draw calls)
features.note: The app-facing sprite batch joins quads into texture runs and refuses a full or empty quad; tested headless in ui/tests/parity_sdk-rest-12.rs. Gap: the shell's frame batch in gpu/batch.rs is still its own copy, and no app submits sprites to the GPU. Built 2026-10-19: gpu_sprites::draw_batch draws the texture runs of a SpriteBatch into a view drawable (axis-aligned quads, nearest texel from a gpu_texture::Texture, vertex tint, source-over, clipping, scale from points to pixels), so an app submits sprites to a view end to end on the CPU. Still a gap: the shell's frame batch in gpu/batch.rs is its own copy and no sprite pass runs on the GPU. Midget check: run `cargo test --offline -p bifrost-app gpu_sprites::tests` on the Midget build host and see every test pass (solid, scaled, textured, mirrored, blended and clipped quads); there is no app UI for it yet, so no click path.

features.apple: Conversion Functions (Metal and Model I/O vertex layouts), Model Errors
features.note: Depends on Model I/O, which BifrOSt does not have

gaps: No app-facing GPU view with a per-frame delegate (MTKView and MTKViewDelegate equivalent) in springboard/sdk/src/
No app-facing GPU texture loader (MTKTextureLoader equivalent); springboard/render/src/imgdec.rs decodes on the CPU only
No app-facing mesh API: the mesh model and loader (ui/src/mesh.rs, mesh_file.rs, render/src/mesh.rs) are not re-exported by bifrost_app and no GPU path draws a mesh.
Presenter (springboard/src/gpu/wl.rs) is shell-internal; its Metal-shaped API has no SDK binding
The GPU stack is GLES on GBM and EGL, not Metal; a Metal-shaped API is only a design note in docs/gpu-first.md
